setup.instructions: Read the mounted brief and source/data before editing. Immutable snapshots and validators must remain unchanged; only explicitly editable source fixtures may be edited. Author the missing web output locally in one turn. Ready denotes supported mechanics and static presentation, not a cooked or accepted result.

turns.content: Design and build Span’s product page from the supplied original commercial packet. Make selection useful and the product understandable. Read fixtures/brief.md and data/product.json for the facts and exact contract; author the visual answer.

checks.description: Validate required nonempty files, local literal resource/import links, JavaScript syntax, immutable data hashes and shared pure-logic vectors. Does not prove rendering, event wiring, accessibility or taste.

At 360px and 1440px, inspect hierarchy and honest product representation. Change size, finish, quantity and mesh; try sold-out selection, replace and clear bag, and recover from invalid inquiry. Check arithmetic shown equals shared logic, no request is sent, keyboard/focus/errors and narrow-screen fit.

display.title: Span
display.summary: A folding laundry rack product page with fit facts, variant estimates, a local bag and a useful inquiry preview.
